provenance.name: CGWB manual groundwater chemical parameters — Haryana and Rajasthan, 2019–2023
provenance.agency: Central Ground Water Board, Government of India
provenance.selection: All rows with parsed sampling year between 2019 and 2023 inclusive; no concentration-based selection.
warnings: Fluoride and Nitrate N columns contain no measurements in these source resources; no findings can be inferred for them.
Nitrate N is labelled mgN/L, not nitrate as NO3 mg/L. It must not be compared directly to a 45 mg/L nitrate limit.
Records are station sampling events, not distinct wells or a representative household survey.
Sampling coverage varies by district and year; missing measurements are not zero.
Zero concentrations are preserved as published; detection limits are not supplied.
Historical 2019–2023 observations do not describe current drinking-water safety.

priority_rules.sort: Eligible first, descending exceedance proportion, descending median excess ratio, descending valid sample count, then district name. One selected parameter only.
